subject: Audit logs: data access evidence request / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@fincobank.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@fincobank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — audit logs / data access

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clear overview of FinCo's audit requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Scope: you asked for examples of "who accessed what/when" for Redwood Private (VPC) — specifically admin and service-account access to user data and model artifacts.
- Deliverables: sample export of access events (CSV + JSON) covering the last 90 days; documentation on available fields, export formats, retention windows, and filtering.
- Outstanding decision needed from you: confirmation whether the retention window you need is 6 months or 12 months for the final deliverable, and whether you want S3 delivery or a signed Drive link.

I've attached a small sample export (audit-log-sample.csv) and our current data-retention summary (redwood-data-retention-policy.pdf) for initial review.

Next steps we propose:
1) I’ll send the 90-day sample export and field mapping by EOD today.
2) Jordan will scope whether a 6- or 12-month extract requires additional engineering time (estimate in 24–48h).
3) Marcus/Lisa confirm preferred delivery method and whether there are any extra filtering requirements (PII redaction, subject-area scoping).

If that all looks right I can schedule a brief follow-up next week to review the sample with your security team.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: audit-log-sample.csv (stub), redwood-data-retention-policy.pdf (stub)
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@fincobank.com>, FinCo Security <security@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — audit logs / data access

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the attachments, very helpful. A few clarifying points from our security team: 

- We need the "who accessed what/when" data for the **last 6 months** initially. If the export includes user identifiers, please make sure we have a mapping for any internal service accounts.
- Preferred delivery is S3 (we can provide a pre-signed URL or a bucket you can write to).
- Export formats: CSV is fine for initial review, but we may ask for NDJSON/JSONL for ingestion into our SIEM.
- Field requests: include event timestamp (ISO8601), requesting principal (user/service account), action type (read/write/export), resource identifier, IP address, and any relevant request ID.

Can you confirm whether you can provide per-resource access logs (e.g., per-object in our customer bucket) and whether logs include both console/API + internal infra access?

Thanks — we’d like to have the 90-day sample today and then the 6-month export within 72 hours if possible.

Best,
Lisa
Director, Information Security
FinCo Bank
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@fincobank.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@fincobank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — audit logs / data access

Lisa — thanks, that’s clear and very helpful. Short answers: 

- We can provide CSV and NDJSON (JSONL) exports. I’m attaching a small CSV sample for the 90-day window; NDJSON export available on request.
- Logs include console (UI) and API access, plus our internal service account activity that touches customer resources. We include request IDs where available.
- We can deliver to an S3 bucket via presigned upload or provide a presigned download link; whichever you prefer.

Jordan is sizing the 6-month extract now — we should have an ETA within 24 hours. Sean added an access-control export as well (see CC).

Attachment: audit-log-sample.csv (stub)

I’ll follow up tomorrow with the exact field mapping and the engineering ETA for the 6-month export.

Regards,
Marissa
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@fincobank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — audit logs / data access

Quick ETA update from infra side: 

- 90-day sample: ready (Marissa sent a stub).
- 6-month export: engineering estimate is ~48 hours to generate the export and run PII mapping/redaction passes. If FinCo needs raw identifiers without redaction for mapping, we can provide that under an NDA — otherwise we’ll provide a mapped identifier set.
- Delivery: we can push to a presigned S3 location or share NDJSON via a secured Drive link.

Action items I’m taking:
- Confirm exact field names and format (CSV headers + NDJSON schema) by EOD.
- Include an access-control-matrix export (access-control-matrix.xlsx) that lists roles and service accounts that have inbound permissions to your resources.

Marissa — please confirm whether FinCo will sign the additional NDA for raw id mapping or whether we should proceed with mapped ids.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@fincobank.com>
Cc: FinCo Security <security@fincobank.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — audit logs / data access

Thanks team — FinCo confirmed we prefer: 

- 6-month export (initial delivery)
- NDJSON/JSONL preferred for SIEM ingestion, but include CSV for quick review
- Delivery via an S3 presigned upload. I’ll share bucket details in a separate email.
- We will sign the limited-scope NDA for raw id mapping; security will route the DocuSign (referenced link: DocuSign: 0xA12B34).

Request from Security (cc’d): when you deliver the export please include a short README that documents field definitions, any known gaps, and whether any deduplication or sampling was performed. Also confirm retention policy for exported artifacts and whether Redwood maintains a copy after delivery.

Once we have the 6-month export and the access-control matrix we’ll run it through our ingestion pipeline and follow up with any questions.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marcus
Head of Cloud Platform
FinCo Bank
